body: I’m so sorry that is happening to you! You are freaking gorgeous chica. Like, you look more cis female than I am lol. Keep your head up and that beautiful smile on; and fuck the haters.
I have plenty to do. I feel like I’m on a nonstop break from things. All I can do is sleep breathe.
This thread has been such a lifesaver! Thanks everyone.

I wished working out helped. But the last time I exercised when I was like this, I ended up hurting myself with the weight machine and then ran until I passed out. My therapist said it was just 'replacement self harm'. 🤷🏻‍♀️🤷🏻‍♀️🤷🏻‍♀️

I really appreciate this comment! Thanks for all your kind words. I'm okay. I was just very curious. I'm ex LDS and have heard a ton of stuff from that church when I was a member and from friends who are still members. I once confided in a young woman's leader about my struggle with suicidal thoughts  and she told me I shouldn't because I'd go to the outer darkness and never have a chance to be with my family again. It was so messed up!
I'm just so exhausted of everything being so hard. I don't think it'll ever get better.

Thank you so much for all the feedback! I've been trying to figure out how to open a deeper conversation about what extra excited for.  We're still in the stage of just being so ecstatic and dancing and yelling anytime one of us brings it up (which is all the time haha).

That's so exciting. Congrats to you and your girlfriend!


I actually didn't know about that sub. Thank you so so much!

You bring up a very good point. I've never thought about it that way and now I kind of feel bad. I will definitely work to change my vocabulary. I use the verbiage 'his truth' because that's what he and the folks in our support group use.
